name: @faber/runtime
description: Faber language runtime package for generated TypeScript: the display namespace (display.value and its renderers), the exact namespace (exact-integer arithmetic and stores), the dec namespace (exact decimal arithmetic and the d64 store), the inf namespace (unbounded-integer arithmetic, comparisons, stores and conversions), the format namespace (the ¶ format-operator renderers), and the regex namespace (@faber/runtime/regex).

scripts.test: node --test dec.test.ts display.test.ts exact.test.ts format.test.ts inf.test.ts regex.test.ts
